parties:
Md. Nurul Hoque Miah ----- Appellant
Vs.
Government of Bangladesh represented by the Secretary, Ministry of Establishment and others ----- Respondents
full_judgment: 20. Mr. Md. Nurul Hoque, the appellant has referred to the case of Abdul Motalab Main Vs. Secretary, Establishment Division and others reported in 1982 BLD 144 and submitted that in service matter cases of all persons eligible for promotion should be considered for promotion and a senor person can not be bypassed unless he is found unfit for promotion over others, the appellant having been found senior and fit to the promoted the respondents acted illegally in not promoting him to the respective posts upto the Commissioner of Taxes with effect from the date due for promotion as detailed in Annexure-K.
